faq.a: Pacific Terrace at 15111 Russell Avenue was built 1988, per the MLS® strata building record.
Pacific Terrace is 9 storeys with 84 apartments.

faq.q: What amenities does Pacific Terrace have?
faq.a: Concierge, an indoor pool, hot tub and sauna, exercise equipment, a library, workshop, guest suite and a rooftop lounge and sundeck.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings of any listing in the building. Call or text 604-928-1361 or email jaredgibbons@royallepage.ca.
